dub_templebar_fiddler.text: Come in, find a seat, and listen. The music starts at lunchtime and finishes whenever it feels like it.
The area is named after Sir William Temple, who lived by the river in the 1600s. His family house and gardens were here.
The 'bar' is an old word for a walkway by the water. Nobody has told the cafe next door.

dublin_quizmaster.text: Right, settle down, the Temple Bar quiz is about to start. Phones away. Yes, Dave, that includes the one in your sock.
Five questions, four answers each. Wrong answers will be remembered and mocked, lovingly.
Fancy a round? Five questions, no phones.

else.text: Grand. The fiddler gets a round in whatever happens.
